text: 2018 is the first year of operations for CreateTO. The firm of PricewaterhouseCoopers was selected as auditors for the year ended December 31, 2018 and they have prepared a draft audit plan for review and approval.

The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Approved the 2018 Draft Audit Plan as set out in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (November 27, 2018) from the Chief Financial Officer, CreateTO. 2. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (November 27, 2018) from the Chief Financial Officer, CreateTO remain confidential in its entirety, as it contains financial information that belongs to the Board of Directors of CreateTO and has monetary value or potential monetary value.
